subject: ExpoTech — lead-capture dataflow & consent review
messages:
From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@acmetech.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: ExpoTech Ops <ops@expotech.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ExpoTech — lead-capture dataflow & consent review

Marcus —

Thanks for coordinating. Acme will be at ExpoTech (booth G12) and we need to finalize how leads captured on the show floor flow into our systems. A few specific asks up front: 

- We need to support both: (A) onsite kiosk captures (badge scan + short form) and (B) reps using mobile app capture.
- Primary CRM is Salesforce (SFDC) but we also need HubSpot as a marketing sync. Can you outline push options (realtime webhook vs batch CSV to SFTP)?
- Consent language: legal wants the exact text that appears on the kiosk and mobile form (GDPR-safe).
- PII handling: which fields will be redacted/encrypted in transit and at rest?

I've attached the expo-kiosk-specs.pdf and a sample CSV export (expo-data-fields.csv) with the fields our team currently captures. Can you review and propose a minimal set we should push to SFDC/HubSpot, plus mapping?

We'd like a live test on Thursday 9/17 if possible.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Huang
Events Lead, Acme Corp
claire.huang@acmetech.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: expo-kiosk-specs.pdf (application/pdf), expo-data-fields.csv (text/csv)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@acmetech.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ExpoTech — lead-capture dataflow & consent review

Hi Claire —

Appreciate the detail and attachments. Quick response with proposed approach so we can lock timelines: 

Plan overview:
- Realtime ingestion: kiosk devices can POST to a Redwood-managed ingestion webhook. This is ideal for HubSpot real-time property updates (we'll map to HubSpot property names).
- Batch/SFTP: for SFDC we'll support a nightly CSV push (SFTP or secure GCS bucket) that SFDC adapter ingests and upserts to Lead/Contact based on email/badge_id.
- Fallbacks: if realtime fails, kiosk will buffer and send a compressed batch when connectivity restores.

Consent and PII:
- Proposed kiosk consent copy (recommended): "By submitting your badge, you agree to be contacted by Acme Corp about products and events. Data will be processed by Acme and Redwood Inference per their privacy policies."
- We'll store a consent_flag and consent_timestamp on each record; all PII in transit uses TLS 1.2+ and at rest uses customer-managed KMS encryption for Private deployments.

Suggested minimal mapping (high level):
- first_name -> FirstName (SFDC) / firstname (HubSpot)
- last_name -> LastName / lastname
- email -> Email / email
- phone -> Phone / phone
- company -> Company / company
- badge_id -> custom:Badge_ID__c / expo_badge_id
- campaign_source -> Campaign_Source__c / campaign_source

Attachments: I attached a short draft (redwood-expo-dataflow-draft.docx) with the technical flows and a sample webhook payload. Can Lauren and Marissa weigh in on exact SFDC field API names and any HubSpot nuances?

We can definitely run a live test on Thursday 9/17 — I suggest 10:00am PT for a short validation window.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Field Ops, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-expo-dataflow-draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Claire Huang <claire.huang@acmetech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ExpoTech — lead-capture dataflow & consent review

Thanks Marcus — adding a few technical specifics and a small ask for Acme: 

SFDC/HUBSPOT mapping notes (proposed):
- SFDC Lead fields (API names):
  - FirstName -> FirstName
  - LastName -> LastName
  - Email -> Email
  - Phone -> Phone
  - Company -> Company
  - Badge_ID__c -> Badge_ID__c (Text, 255)
  - Campaign_Source__c -> Campaign_Source__c (Picklist)

- HubSpot properties:
  - firstname, lastname, email, phone, company, expo_badge_id, campaign_source

Data hygiene / PII handling:
- Do not send full government ID or scanned images to either system. Badge barcode -> badge_id only.
- If vendor wants to capture notes with sensitive content, those should be flagged and stored in encrypted notes (not sent to SFDC/HubSpot).
- Retention: Acme, confirm desired retention policy (30/90/365 days) so we can add TTL to nightly exports.

Consent wording (GDPR-friendly) suggestion — short version for kiosk: "I consent to Acme Corp processing my information to receive marketing communications. I can withdraw consent at any time."
Please confirm if legal needs the long-form link included on the kiosk.

I've uploaded an export-ready mapping CSV (sfdc-hubspot-mapping.csv) to the shared Drive folder. Marcus — once we have final confirmation on retention and campaign_source values, I'll finalize the adapter and a test manifest for 9/17.

- Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Product Ops, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

Attachments: sfdc-hubspot-mapping.csv (text/csv)

From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@acmetech.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ExpoTech — lead-capture dataflow & consent review

Awesome, thanks everyone. Quick confirmations from Acme side: 

- Consent language: short version is fine for the kiosk. Legal prefers adding a link to privacy policy on the kiosk screen; we'll provide the link by EOD.
- Retention: 90 days for marketing leads, 365 for enterprise pipeline (we'll flag).
- campaign_source and expo_booth_id are required fields for our reporting tool — please include them in both SFDC and HubSpot mappings.

We can do the live test on Thu 9/17 at 10:00am PT. I'll send a test badge payload during the window and confirm receipts. Also uploaded signed-nda.pdf to the Drive; the DocuSign room link is in the thread if you need the MSA signed.

Thanks — Claire
Claire Huang
